amendment_note: Before any run on this frozen historical evaluation set, the four adequate-bug cases were changed from comment_only to no_action to match the intervention-only workflow contract. Source inputs and inadequate-bug decisions were not changed.
decision_rule: Only incomplete bug reports receive a triage action: one comment plus needs-repro. An adequate bug report has a runnable fenced example importing pandas, expected and actual behavior, and concrete pandas/Python/OS versions; it receives no action. Features, documentation requests and other non-bugs also receive no action.
